rules.title: Pair lookup
rules.text: Draw two distinct cards; order does not matter. Exactly one outcome exists for each unordered pair.

rules.title: Rewards and rarity
rules.text: Direct gold rewards are capped at 1,000 gp. Published items are capped at Very Rare. Rare and Very Rare rewards are Exceptional.

rules.title: Upgrade limits
rules.text: Magic weapon +3, magic armor +2; never exceed Very Rare as a whole item.

rules.title: Additional weapon damage
rules.text: At most one deck-created additional-damage enchantment on a single weapon; once per turn where expressly stated.

rules.title: Attunement
rules.text: Published items retain official attunement; homebrew only when explicitly stated.

rules.title: Upgrade fallback
rules.text: If an Exceptional outcome requires an eligible item but none is owned, a bound, nontransferable rune holds the upgrade for later use; Perfected Armament instead creates a +2 dagger.

rules.title: Curse cleansing
rules.text: Use each outcome’s specified removal/cleansing condition; published curses use published rules.
